## 范围

任务要求实现 row_softmax_fp32_v1 的完整有效域：m in [1,32]，n in [128,1024]，CUDA FP32，x 与 out 连续、任意合法 storage offset、存储互不重叠，原地写入给定 out 并返回同一对象；构建、正确性、覆盖与保真是独立硬检查，完整 forward 计时采用四 shape 等权的几何均值软目标。当前收录仅 root 一份完整设计，承担全部有效域；四个覆盖 shape shape_m1_n128、shape_m1_n1024、shape_m32_n128、shape_m32_n1024 均派发至 root，各占权重 1/4，平等对待。尚无实现与实测证据；数值误差、编译与性能结论待 Coder 验证。

META_DATA:
  Name: row_softmax
  Describe: Row-wise numerically stable softmax of an FP32 CUDA matrix, written in place into the supplied output tensor.
  Source: triton-lang/triton@0add68262ab0a2e33b84524346cb27cbb2787356:python/tutorials/02-fused-softmax.py
  Version: 1
CONTRACT:
  Algorithm_requirement:
    Compute:
    - Name: Row softmax
      Math: |
        m in [1, 32]; n in [128, 1024]; 0<=i<m; 0<=j<n. x and out are CUDA FP32, shape (m,n), stride (n,1), arbitrary legal storage offsets, requires_grad=False and distinct storage. Model().forward(x,out) runs eager inference on one call stream; CUDA Graph and concurrent streams are unsupported. z=FP64(x_before); m[i]=max_j z[i,j]; g[i,j]=exp(z[i,j]-m[i])/sum_k exp(z[i,k]-m[i]). Write FP32 approximations to g into the original out region and return the identical out object. Preserve x bytes, both original storage/view signatures and every backing byte outside out. Recompute changed legal x; no test-number, invocation-order or precomputed-output dependency. Evaluator files are not writable.
    Golden_reference:
      Source: KernelSchema@2efc92479db497e0ecf681e276ecddc72cad0de6:examples/workflows/row_softmax/evaluator/golden.py::softmax_fp64
      Tolerance:
        y: All output elements finite; abs(fp64(actual)-g)<=2e-6+2e-5*abs(g)
    Input:
      out:
        dtype: fp32
        meaning: Supplied original output buffer
        range: arbitrary, including NaN
        shape:
        - row: m
        - column: n
      x:
        dtype: fp32
        meaning: Read-only logits on the selected CUDA device
        range: finite values in [-20, 20]
        shape:
        - row: m
        - column: n
    Output:
      y:
        dtype: fp32
        meaning: Identical out object with original region written
        shape:
        - row: m
        - column: n
  Hardware_specification:
    Architecture: NVIDIA Blackwell SM103
    Device: NVIDIA L20D
    Execution:
      cta: Cooperative thread block on one SM; one CTA owns a complete row
      warp: SIMT scheduling group within the owning CTA
    Feature:
      register: Thread-private registers retain row values through their consumers
    Stack:
      Language: Triton DSL 3.7.1
      Toolchain: PyTorch 2.9.0+cu130; CUDA build 13.0; fixed L20D target
    Wiki:
      Hardware: NVIDIA/cuda-samples@0ec046d5e99d7214cc8e9fbac2cc1e66f3019878:Common/helper_cuda.h
      Microbench: KernelSchema@7d5fb60cf1d6f9ef7cf63dff757250bb4f614ab1:examples/workflows/row_softmax/references/l20d-target-b16.md
      Profile: KernelSchema@7d5fb60cf1d6f9ef7cf63dff757250bb4f614ab1:examples/workflows/row_softmax/references/l20d-target-b16.md
      Programming:
        Language: triton-lang/triton@0add68262ab0a2e33b84524346cb27cbb2787356:docs/programming-guide/chapter_1/introduction.rst
      Sota:
        Kernel: triton-lang/triton@0add68262ab0a2e33b84524346cb27cbb2787356:python/tutorials/02-fused-softmax.py
        Schema: KernelSchema@7d5fb60cf1d6f9ef7cf63dff757250bb4f614ab1:examples/workflows/row_softmax/references/l20d-target-b16.md
DESIGN:
  Math_reshape:
    Thesis: |
      Preserve the contract's stable softmax math and fuse it into one pass per row. A row holds at most 1024 FP32 elements (4 KiB), so the complete row fits the owning CTA's registers; the row maximum, shifted exponentials, row sum and normalization are evaluated on-chip without materializing intermediates and without re-reading x. All arithmetic stays in FP32 with the contract's max subtraction; no approximate operation is declared, so only ordinary FP32 rounding separates the result from the FP64 golden. The pinned Triton fused-softmax tutorial motivates the fusion; its persistent multi-row loop, output allocation and occupancy logic are not adopted because the Task fixes one CTA per row and the supplied out ABI.
    Rewrite:
    - Name: Row maximum
      Math: |
        For 0 <= i < m:
        r[i] = max_{0 <= j < n} x[i,j]
      Symbol:
        r:
          meaning: Per-row maximum of x used as the stability shift
          shape:
          - row: m
          dtype: fp32
    - Name: Shifted exponentials and row sum
      Math: |
        For 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n:
        e[i,j] = exp(x[i,j] - r[i])
        For 0 <= i < m:
        s[i] = sum_{0 <= k < n} e[i,k]
        e is consumed by the sum and the normalization in the same pass and is not materialized outside the owning CTA.
      Symbol:
        s:
          meaning: Per-row sum of shifted exponentials
          shape:
          - row: m
          dtype: fp32
    - Name: Normalize into the supplied output
      Math: |
        For 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n:
        y[i,j] = e[i,j] / s[i]
        y is written as FP32 into the original out region only; every byte outside that region is unchanged.
      Ledger:
        Baseline: Contract formula evaluated as separate device passes that materialize the row maximum, shifted values, exponentials, row sums and normalized values
        Gain: Element traffic per call (8*m*n + 4*m) -> 2*m*n FP32 elements read and written; intermediate materialization m*n -> 0 elements outside CTA registers
  Work_schedule:
    Thesis: |
      Rows are independent and one row fits one CTA's registers, so the computation is partitioned by row with one CTA per row; there is no cross-worktile reduction, handoff or refill. The grid holds m worktiles (m <= 32), far fewer than the device's SMs; the four coverage shapes are all small and the timing goal is soft, so full-device occupancy is not pursued. Each worktile writes exactly its own row of the original out region, keeping the side-effect contract direct.
    Step:
      MAIN:
        Describe: Compute the complete softmax of one row of x and write it into the matching row of the supplied out tensor.
        Decomposition:
          Strategy: |
            BLOCK = next_power_of_2(n) >= n is the padded column width of one worktile, so a single vector covers the row; column positions j >= n are masked inactive and are neither read nor written. The row is addressed from the tensor base pointers, which already include the legal storage offsets, with row stride n elements.
          Partition:
            row:
              meaning: One output row computed from the matching input row
              size: m
              tile: 1
          Worktile:
            Invariant:
              x_row:
                meaning: Input row read by this worktile
                shape:
                - column: n
                dtype: ref:CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement::x.dtype
          Target:
            Single_tile:
              y_row:
                meaning: Softmax output row written into out
                shape:
                - column: n
                dtype: ref:CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement::y.dtype
        Mapping:
          Strategy: One CTA owns one complete row, following the registered cta execution unit; no worker spans multiple rows and no row spans multiple workers.
          Worker:
            unit: cta
            unit_count: 1
          Worker_count: m
        Schedule:
          Worktile_order:
          - by: row
            direction: ascending
          Worker_assignment:
            Preassigned:
              start: worker_id
              count: 1
            Refill: none
            Exit: assigned_done
    Flow:
      Launch:
      - step: [MAIN]
  Tile_pipeline:
    Thesis: |
      A single MAIN role of four warps performs the whole row serially: one masked vector load, row maximum, shifted exponentials, row sum, normalization and one masked store. Four warps cover the widest row (1024 columns) with a small per-thread element count and remain legal for the 128-column shapes. With one worktile per worker there is no buffer, no cross-worktile state and no role split; the only on-chip region is the register copy of the padded row retained through its consumers, protected by the serial pipe order.
    Step:
      MAIN:
        Storage:
          row_block:
            meaning: Padded input row held in registers between the load and its consumers
            depth: 1
            location: register
            shape:
            - column: BLOCK
            dtype: fp32
            total_size: 4*BLOCK
        Role:
          MAIN:
            Info:
              Describe: Cooperatively load one row, evaluate the stable softmax and write the result into out.
              Member: warp[0:4]
              Using_verb:
                load:
                  row:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Read x_row from global memory into row_block through the row base pointer with the column mask j < n; masked lanes take no part in later computation and are not read
                compute:
                  row_max:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Compute r for this row as the maximum of the active lanes of row_block; no global access
                  shifted_exp:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Replace the active lanes of row_block by e[i,j] = exp(x_row[j] - r) computed in FP32
                  row_sum:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Compute s for this row as the FP32 sum of the shifted exponentials over the active lanes
                  normalize:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Replace the active lanes of row_block by y_row[j] = e[i,j] / s computed in FP32
                store:
                  out:
                    execution_mode: serial
                    describe: Write the active lanes of row_block into the matching row of the original out region through the out base pointer with the column mask j < n; done covers visibility of the written row
            Pipe:
            - load:row
            - compute:row_max
            - compute:shifted_exp
            - compute:row_sum
            - compute:normalize
            - store:out
